cohort: The study included 89 consenting parous Nigerian women aged 20-45 years.
finding: Inter-rectus distance significantly correlated with waist circumference and waist-to-hip ratio, indicating these are predictors of inter-rectus distance in parous women.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed no significant correlation with inter-rectus distance.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken in parous women, and information on the age of their last child was obtained.
